papers.title: Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Discrete diffusion language models generate text by iteratively denoising an entire response in parallel. At each step, they predict tentative tokens for every masked position, committing the confident predictions to the output and discarding the unconfident ones. We show that the discarded tokens are in fact a useful lookahead signal for retrieval-augmented generation: even low-confidence tokens often surface salient entities early in the denoising trajectory, enabling retrieval of stronger evi
papers.llm_reason: Self-Augmenting Retrieval 把离散扩散 LM 的'低置信度丢弃 token'重新定义为 RAG 的前瞻检索信号——扩散去噪的副产品变成主动检索入口。这是 Diffusion LM × RAG 两个活跃方向的首次明确交叉，Cornell Weinberger 团队加持。直接价值在于：当 Masked LM / Diffusion LM 走向产品化时，检索路径不再是'用户 query → 检索'而是'中间去噪状态 → 检索'，这与传统 autoregressive LM 的 RAG 管线根本不同，需要新基础设施。

papers.title: Pretraining Recurrent Networks without Recurrence
papers.abstract: Training recurrent neural networks (RNNs) requires assigning credit across long sequences of computations. Standard backpropagation through time (BPTT) addresses this problem poorly: it is sequential in time, limiting parallelism, and suffers from vanishing or exploding gradients, making long-range associations difficult to learn. We propose Supervised Memory Training (SMT), a method for training nonlinear RNNs that sidesteps recurrent credit propagation entirely by reducing RNN training to supe
papers.llm_reason: Supervised Memory Training (SMT) 把 RNN 训练从 BPTT 还原为监督学习，绕开循环信用传播——本质上是把'时间维度的信用分配'转化为'显存状态的监督目标'。MIT Isola 团队。对长上下文 LM 训练（Mamba/RWKV/线性注意力）有方向性启发：不依赖梯度沿时间回传也能学到长程依赖，可能解锁更长上下文窗口的高效训练。

papers.title: Operation-Guided Progressive Human-to-AI Text Transformation Benchmark for Multi-Granularity AI-Text Detection
papers.abstract: As AI writing assistants become increasingly integrated into real-world drafting and revision workflows, many documents are no longer purely human-written or AI-generated, but instead result from progressive human-AI co-editing. However, existing AI-text detection benchmarks largely focus on final outputs and provide limited understanding of how AI authorship signals emerge, accumulate, or disappear throughout the revision process. We introduce OpAI-Bench, an operation-guided benchmark for study
papers.llm_reason: OpAI-Bench 是首个'操作引导'的 AI 文本检测 benchmark，明确建模渐进式人-AI 共编工作流（draft → AI revise → human edit → AI polish）——这正是 Notion AI / Grammarly / Google Docs AI / Cursor 写作侧的真实使用形态。当前 AI 文本检测器在共编场景下精度崩塌已是产业共识（OpenAI Detector 已下线、GPTZero 在共编下精度大幅下降）。benchmark 直接对应产品评测缺口，immediate 价值明确。

papers.title: Regret Minimization with Adaptive Opponents in Repeated Games
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with \emph{adaptive} opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of \emph{external regret} in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players' counterfactual reasoning, we introduce {\tt Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)}, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the \emph{realized} and the \emph{best-in-hindsight} accumulated utility when all playe
papers.llm_reason: 引入 Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret) 度量自适应对手下的重复博弈后悔——区别于标准 external regret，建模'所有玩家都在反事实推理'的多智能体场景。MIT Ozdaglar/Zhang 团队。理论价值高但工程应用间接：可服务于 LLM agent 多方谈判、自动定价、广告竞价、安全对抗场景的评估基线，但当前 LLM agent benchmark（如 AgentBench/WebArena）尚未引入 RP-Regret。

papers.title: DNQ: Deep Nash Q-Network for Partially Observable n-Player Games
papers.abstract: Many real-world competitive systems require multiple decision-makers to act simultaneously under shared constraints, limited information, and repeated interaction, as in auctions, resource allocation, and security competition. We study multi-turn simultaneous bidding as a controlled testbed for such problems and propose DNQ, a solver-in-the-loop equilibrium supervision framework for training bidding agents. DNQ alternates between trajectory collection, critic-based payoff estimation, equilibrium
papers.llm_reason: DNQ 把'求解器在环的均衡监督'引入多人部分可观测博弈训练：轨迹收集 → critic 估计支付 → 均衡求解 → 监督训练循环。对拍卖、资源分配、安全竞争有直接方法论价值。但相对已有 NFSP / PSRO 系列，工程突破性中等；更适合作为多智能体 RL 训练栈的方法资产保存。

papers.title: Code2LoRA: Hypernetwork-Generated Adapters for Code Language Models under Software Evolution
papers.abstract: Code language models need repository-level context to resolve imports, APIs, and project conventions. Existing methods inject this knowledge as long inputs (retrieved through RAG or dependency analysis) or through per-repository fine-tuning and LoRA -- costly at repository scale and brittle to evolving codebases. papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. papers.title: TailLoR: Protecting Principal Components in Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Parameter-efficient finetuning methods based on spectral decomposition have enabled progress in Continual Learning. papers.title: RREDCoT: Segment-Level Reward Redistribution for Reasoning Models
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in reasoning language models have been driven by Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. Most often, these rely on the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm or modifications thereof to steer the models to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces.
